main.description: An immutable named pointer to a manifest. The record key is '{projectName}:{version}', making uniqueness per (project, version) mechanical and enabling AppView-free resolution. Version strings follow the project-name grammar (lowercase alphanumerics, interior hyphens) but allow dots. The version string cannot contain colons, but the rkey must contain exactly one colon. Valid only when same-DID with the referenced project, and only when target references a manifest of that same project.

project.description: The software.release.project this pointer belongs to. Must be same-DID.

version.description: Version string (e.g. v1.0.0, 2026.10.13). Follows the project-name grammar, minus colons. MUST match the record rkey after the colon.

changelog.description: Canonical site.standard.document or website changelog linked at version creation. The document may be published by a different DID. This URI does not pin the document's contents.

manifest.description: Strong reference to the software.release.manifest this version stamps. MUST belong to the same project.
